## Sample configuration (upstream)

```
$ git clone https://github.com/sigstore/cosign
$ cd cosign
$ go install ./cmd/cosign
$ $(go env GOPATH)/bin/cosign
```

```
$ cosign sign --key cosign.key $BLOB_URI_DIGEST
Enter password for private key:
